quotations.old_english: Þá se biscop tó mé cwóm, ðá grétte hé mé sóna and [h]álette his leódþeáwe
Ic, Béda, Crístes ðeów and mæssepreóst, sende grétan þone leófastan cyning and hálettan Ceólwulf
quotations.latin: gloriosissimo regi Ceoluulfo Baeda famulus Christi et Presbyter

source_text: hálettan. Add: , hǽlettan :-- Gif gé hálettaþ (salutaveritis) eówre bróþer, Mt. R. 5, 47. Hǽleteþ þæt hús salutate domum, 10, 12. Þá se biscop tó mé cwóm, ðá grétte hé mé sóna and [h]álette his leódþeáwe cum me more rituque salutaret, Nar. 27, 17. Ic, Béda, Crístes ðeów and mæssepreóst, sende grétan þone leófastan cyning and hálettan Ceólwulf gloriosissimo regi Ceoluulfo Baeda famulus Christi et Presbyter, Bd. praef.; Sch. 1. 3. [O. H. Ger. heilazen salutare.] v. ge-hálettan.
